name: bytemyfaceoff
label: byteMyFaceOff
description: Full-frame explainers for the byteMyFaceOff dev videos: app diagrams, counters, card lists, spec files and blog-post cards, in Git Gud's dark lane colours.
author: Joe Lloyd

templates.name: FourApps
templates.label: Four apps
templates.description: Four app cards around a central protocol hub, linked by animated lines with packets, revealed one at a time; the newest card glows.

fields.default:
Desktop app|what you have seen
Headless daemon|git on a box with no screen
Relay|reach it from anywhere
Phone companion|read-only, live
fields.description: Four lines of "title|subtitle", clockwise from top-left: desktop, server, relay, phone icons.
Seconds from the clip start at which each card appears, comma separated.
Opacity of the dark backdrop over the footage below.

templates.name: StatCounter
templates.label: Stat counter
templates.description: Tiles whose numbers count up as each is mentioned.

fields.description: Seconds from the clip start at which each tile appears and starts counting.

templates.name: CardList
templates.label: Card list
templates.description: Numbered cards that land one at a time; the newest is lit. Column for rules or steps, grid for episode lists.

fields.default:
Show me the whole history
Never hide what git is doing
Reach my repos wherever they live

fields.description: Seconds from the clip start at which each card lands.
column stacks wide cards; grid is two columns.
Number on the first card; the rest count up from it.

templates.name: SpecCard
templates.label: Spec card
templates.description: A spec file in an editor window, typed out with SHALL, WHEN and THEN lit up.

fields.description: File path in the window's title bar.

fields.default:
The system SHALL record every git command it runs.
WHEN the app runs any git operation
THEN an entry appears in the git activity log

templates.name: PostCard
templates.label: Post card
templates.description: A blog post as a card, with an optional stamp that thumps on at a set time.

fields.default: Be The Pilot, Not The Co-Pilot

fields.description: Optional line or two from the post.
Optional stamp text, empty for none.
Seconds from the clip start when the stamp lands.
